workflowRecommendation: One implementer, tasks in order, test-driven: Task 1 writes the five envoy.test.ts changes and watches four of them fail on the current deliver(); Task 2 makes the one code change; Task 3 updates the docs; Task 4 runs CI's exact four pi-envoy steps, commits, pushes, opens the PR. No smoke rig, no throwaway OMP profile, no touch of ~/.omp/profiles/legion or ~/.omp/plugins (spec acceptance 5; deployment instructions).

implement: legion-worker: the phase contract — bind to $LEGION_WORKSPACE, jj split per logical change, .legion/implement.json, bookmark push, PR body in the READY format with `Dispatch: LEGION-109`.
test-driven-development: land the test changes of Task 1 first and observe the four expected failures before editing deliver(); the failing run is the evidence the tests guard the new order.
verification-before-completion: run bun run lint, typecheck, test, build in packages/pi-envoy (the exact steps of CI job pi-envoy) and paste the pass counts into implement.json before claiming done.
test: legion-worker: the tester writes the PR body's E2E line; here it states that pre-merge smoke is withdrawn by Sami's 2026-09-13 standing order (spec acceptance 5), quotes the unit run at the PR head, and names the operator's post-deploy smoke command and release.
verification-before-completion: re-run bun run test in packages/pi-envoy at the PR head and quote the pass count; never start smoke-delivery.sh, a smoke rig, or a scratch plugin tree.
review: legion-worker: one review per round through the reviews API with the Legion footer; verify CI, Threads, and E2E facts against GitHub, not the handoff.

verification-before-completion: check the two structural facts no unit test can — the receipt sits after renderInbound() and before the subscriptionRemovedTopics loop, and the trailing publish is gone — and that packages/pi-envoy/AGENTS.md states the new order.

spec: dispatch://LEGION-109/spec (Design, Errors, Testing are the contract); parent dispatch://LEGION-101/spec section Design, Plugin bullet.
summary: Move the receipt publish in deliver() (packages/pi-envoy/extensions/envoy.ts) from the end of the function to immediately after renderInbound() returns, guarded by the same condition (reply !== "" && subject === agentSubject(sessionID)), wrapped so a failed publish is logged and delivery continues; delete the trailing publish; nothing else in deliver() moves. Dedupe on dedupe_key is untouched (the daemon child LEGION-107 relies on it). Prove it with five unit-test changes in envoy.test.ts and update the receipt sentence in packages/pi-envoy/AGENTS.md.

Invariants the reviewer will check by reading: (1) the receipt block is after renderInbound() and before the subscriptionRemovedTopics loop, so a frame renderInbound throws on is still not acknowledged (spec Errors row 1) and the receipt precedes the dedupe check, the inbox update, armAskReminder (workspace base only), postDispatchReply, askEphemeral, and sendMessage; (2) exactly one `.publish(reply)` remains in envoy.ts; (3) the dedupe block (`dedupeKeys.add` after a successful injection, nothing on a throw) is byte-identical; (4) no new import (agentSubject and ensureConnection already exist).

3a. packages/pi-envoy/AGENTS.md Overview (lines 12-16; the same text is at line 14 on main). Replace the sentence 'The agent pump replies after it accepts the envelope, so the listener can turn a claimed-but-deaf holder into a `delivery_failed` exception after two seconds.' with:
steps.text: The agent pump replies the moment the envelope is decoded — before the inbox update, any Dispatch call, or the session injection — so the listener's two-second receipt window measures decoding, not the host's turn: a claimed-but-deaf holder still becomes a `delivery_failed` exception, and a busy one no longer does (LEGION-101). A frame that cannot be decoded is still never acknowledged, and a receipt that fails to publish is logged while delivery continues.

steps.prBody: First line `Dispatch: LEGION-109`. Then one plain paragraph for a phone reader: when a message for a Legion role reaches a busy session, the plugin now tells the message bus 'received' as soon as it has read the message, instead of after it has finished its own work; under load the old order missed the bus's two-second window and the same message was sent again and again (the incident is LEGION-101). Then a 'Release' paragraph: this merge cuts the patch release above the latest pi-legion-envoy tag — 1.27.3 if nothing else releases first — and the operator installs it into the live profile; after that install, `packages/pi-envoy/scripts/smoke-delivery.sh` against the installed plugin is the live proof at the operator's timing, and the parent issue's production hour is the end-to-end proof. Then the READY-format `## Verification` block from the legion-worker skill: CI (workflow 'Legion Envoy and Contracts' job pi-envoy plus 'Tests' pr-title/lint/typecheck/test at the head sha), Threads (0 at open), Thermo (left for the reviewer), E2E (left for the tester; see acceptanceProof[4]), Fast-follow: none, Chain: not stacked.
